status: adopted local engineering baseline; participant approval and runtime measurements pending
self_transition_rule: No new lifecycle self-transition; identical completed retry returns original evidence. Unknown outcome reconciles; changed ID payload rejects. Reads are not lifecycle transitions.
guard_semantics: All listed guards must be independently established by the owning authority; guard names are oracles, not implemented runtime enforcement.

guards.supported_complete_terms: Supported manifest, plot and complete proposed terms are valid.
guards.unfunded_no_unknown_funding: No canonical funding and no unknown pending funding outcome.
guards.current_independent_offer: Offer owner/authorization and current version are verified in the correct namespace.
guards.all_required_approvals: All required parties approved the same current canonical digest.
guards.canonical_exact_funding: Confirmed canonical funding matches exact token, parties, immutable allocations and agreed deadlines.
guards.before_work_deadline: Authoritative now is strictly before fixed workDeadline.
guards.approval_expired: The adopted unfunded approval validity has expired.
guards.journaled_bounded_purchase: One requester-authorized capped route/recipient purchase intent is durable.
guards.canonical_bound_whole_kit_claim: A sufficiently confirmed atomic whole-KIT burn and fixed-target claim is canonical.
guards.actual_reconciled_delivery: Durable plugin receipt and exact actual stock reconcile with the fixed claim and backing ledger.
guards.current_revision_and_lease: Current revision and actor/region task lease are valid at execution.
guards.structural_lock_acquired: Structural lock is durably acquired before inspection begins.
guards.actual_complete_failed_report: Actual pinned inspection has a complete failure report and no pass was issued.
guards.explicit_incomplete_reason: Inspection is incomplete/invalidated with retained actual evidence and reason.
guards.no_usable_pass_or_unknown_acceptance: No issued pass remains usable and no acceptance outcome is unknown.
guards.stock_and_region_permitted: Required actual job stock and approved task region permit the bounded action.
guards.complete_16_case_pass: Exactly all 16 distinct cases pass from actual lamp observations for the pinned run.
guards.protected_matching_agreement_revision: Signed report, agreement, manifest and still-protected structural revision match.
guards.valid_pass_review_and_escrow_time: Execution time is before every applicable pass/review/absolute expiry.
guards.canonical_requester_acceptance: Canonical confirmed contract outcome carries bound requester authorization.
guards.all_fixed_rewards_confirmed_claimed: Every immutable recipient allocation has a canonical successful actual claim.
guards.absolute_expiry_reached: Authoritative chain time is at or beyond immutable absolute expiry.
guards.escrow_unaccepted: Escrow has not selected Accepted/Paid terminal labor outcome.
guards.canonical_refund_to_requester: Canonical successful allowed refund pays original requester once.
